book.name: Nambas
book.title: Nambas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Jidan Langa Deset Kantri

content: Det waifwan garra abum sambala ebrijing du
Detlot boswan blanga detlot femili blanga Giliyad, hubin det san blanga Mekiya en grensan blanga Manesa, hubin det san blanga Josef, olabat na bin go langa Mosis en langa detlot najalot lida.

Olabat bin tok, “YAWEI bin dalim yumob blanga kadimat det kantri langa ola Isreil pipul wen yumob tjakambat detlot speshalwan ston. En imbin dalim yumob blanga gibit det kantri langa det men gulum Selafad langa im doda.
Bat yumob garra jinggabat. If olabat merrit langa eni men brom najawan klen, olabat kantri garra jidan blanga det klen, en wanim melabat abum garra jidan mowa lilwan.

Langa det yiya blanga det lowa wen ola kantri garra gobek langa detlot boswan, laik Mosis bin gibit, det kantri blanga Selafad dodamob garra gobek langa det klen weya deibin merrit, en melabat garra lujim det kantri brom melabat klen.” Lagijat na deibin tok.
Wal Mosis bin dalim detlot Isreil pipul najawan wed brom YAWEI, “Wanim det Manesa klen bin tok, olabat rait.
YAWEI bin tok langa detlot doda blanga Selafad, ‘Yumob gin merrit langa eni men brom yumob ronwan klen.’
Det kantri blanga ola Isreil pipul garra jidan langa im ronwan klen.
Ebri gel hu garram kantri langa eni Isreil klen im garra merrit wan men brom det klen igin. Lagijat na ola Isreil pipul garra gedim det kantri blanga im grengrenfathamob.
En wan klen kaan hendimoba det kantri langa najawan klen. Ebri klen garra kipgon maindimbat im ronwan kantri.” Lagijat na Mosis bin tok.
Wal Mala, Taisa, Hogla, Milka en Nowa, detlot doda blanga Selafad, bin dum wanim YAWEI bin dalim Mosis, en olabat bin merrit langa olabat ronwan rileishanmob.
Deibin merrit langa det femili langa det klen blanga Manesa det san blanga Josef, en olabat kantri bin jidan langa olabat fatha klen.
Dijan na det lowa weya YAWEI bin gibit langa ola Isreil pipul thru langa Mosis, deya langa det plein kantri blanga Moweb najasaid langa det Jodan Riba brom Jeriko. Binij na.
